company.name: Polity
company.team: One founder working with AI agents; no employees.
company.current_state: Polity Social (the polity-app web app, with Polity Search on its home page) is in build and use. Polity OS has an observer-mode prototype that reads public records only. The other products are defined but not built.
standing_decisions: D-038: no services sold to governments before Stage 2; before Stage 2, everything about government serves the public.

core.source: Vision, Mission, Promise working lock, 2026-07-27 (applied to VISION_SPEC as a Class 2 patch)
core.promise: When you trust Polity, you can find the institutional geometry that governs you, rendered with primary-source evidence or an explicit incomplete grade.
core.promised_to: Members of the public: the people governed by the institutions Polity indexes.
core.must_not: Spin or unlabeled persuasion delivered under Polity's name.
core.competence: Indexing institutional geometry (jurisdictions, institutions, offices, seats, occupants, instruments, events, primary records) and rendering it with retrieval, quotation, grading and citation, including honest incompleteness.

social.name: Polity Social
social.description: The civic social network and Polity's public home: Polity Search over the index, representatives and places by address, notebooks, news, quantitative views, and pages for organisations (absorbs Notebook, Quant, News and the website builder).

docket.name: Docket
docket.description: A friend-group conversation docket: friends form a group, add topics and media sources, and vote on what to discuss. Format first (works on paper), could be a plugin for Telegram, Discord or Slack, and absorbs the classroom and education use. Debate is one mode; good conversation is the goal.

polity-os.name: Polity OS
polity-os.faces: governments and organisations as tenants, citizens as members
polity-os.allowed_from_reason: D-038 makes it the Stage 2 product. Mapping Polity's Stage 2 to the Beachhead phase is a draft assumption.
polity-os.description: One national multi-tenant operating system for governing bodies: governments and organisations run their procedures, agendas, votes and records on it; citizens are members. Merges the Citizens and Government editions and Justice. Today only an observer that turns public records into advisory validity reports.

data.name: Polity Data
data.faces: institutions, developers and researchers (no direct public face)
data.description: The cited, structured index of institutional records, offered headless: API, datasets and reports for institutions, media, researchers and developers. Most justice-record work lives here.

nico.name: Nico
nico.description: A personal knowledge system that models a person's own values and ideas (Idionaut is one mode). No stated link yet to civic records.
